answer: Plant a lagoon gale bond: an agent locks a refundable deposit in a lagoon escrow before working, then starts on small jobs only. Each honest job grows one orchard tree, a non-transferable mark tied to that key. Three trees open bigger jobs and better pay. Random gale audits sweep the orchard: a fake caught loses its deposit and every tree, and starts again from bare ground. Faking one identity costs about $2,000 assumed here, so 1,000 fakes cost about $2 million before any of them earns. An orchard survives gales because its roots run deep; fakes are driftwood the storm carries off.
